title: Empirical Variational Bayes Factorization for Longitudinal Matrix Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.25065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collecting high-dimensional data over time for multiple individuals is increasingly common in biomedical research, particularly in studies of disease progression or molecular time-course experiments. Often data are missing or the timepoints are irregularly spaced across individuals. There is a lack of flexible methodology to explore latent patterns of change over time and account for missing data. We propose an empirical variational Bayes (EVB) approach to factorize high-dimensional longitudinal data, in which the underlying factors have temporal correlation over time. The EVB approach is computationally efficient and accommodates flexible covariance structures over time with automatic determination of all hyper-parameters (including the underlying rank, i.e., number of factors). Simulations demonstrate that the approach captures the underlying signal more precisely than other strategies, and performs well with respect to missing data

translated_title: 纵向矩阵数据的经验变分贝叶斯因子分解
translated_abstract: 在生物医学研究中，为多个个体随时间收集高维数据正变得越来越普遍，尤其是在疾病进展研究或分子时间进程实验中。通常情况下，数据存在缺失，或不同个体之间的时间点间隔不规则。目前缺乏灵活的方法来探索随时间变化的潜在模式并处理缺失数据。我们提出了一种经验变分贝叶斯（EVB）方法来对高维纵向数据进行因子分解，其中潜在因子具有时间上的相关性。EVB方法计算高效，能够灵活适应随时间变化的协方差结构，并自动确定所有超参数（包括潜在秩，即因子数量）。模拟研究表明，该方法比其他策略更精确地捕捉潜在信号，并且在处理缺失数据方面表现良好。
tldr: 提出了一种经验变分贝叶斯因子分解方法，能够高效处理具有时间相关性的高维纵向矩阵数据，自动确定所有超参数，并有效应对缺失数据和不规则时间点的挑战。
en_tdlr: We propose a computationally efficient empirical variational Bayes factorization method for high-dimensional longitudinal matrix data that captures temporal correlation, automatically determines all hyperparameters including the underlying rank, and robustly handles missing data and irregular timepoints.
